text:
Rae (docs): Quick PR up for a small troubleshooting appendix for air-gapped installs that covers HSM management ports, KMS TLS checks, and a doc link fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428
Kofi (eng-infra): Thanks. Can you include a minimal nc and curl combo so customers without openssl can still validate connectivity?
Rae (docs): Yup. Draft snippet (no inline comments so it's paste-friendly):
```
# DNS (UDP/TCP) via placeholder resolver
nslookup api.internal.redwood.example <resolver-ip>
# TCP probe for HSM mgmt port
nc -vz <hsm-mgmt-ip> <hsm-port>
# HTTPS KMS healthcheck, use customer CA if needed
curl -I --cacert /path/to/customer-ca.pem https://<kms-fqdn>/health
```
Jin (security): Add a short line reminding to use placeholders and not to upload real hostnames to public repos. Also note that some HSM admin interfaces expect the pre-NAT source IP.
Rae (docs): Added the placeholder reminder and a troubleshooting bullet: "connection timed out -> check firewall/NAT and HSM ACLs keyed to source IPs".
Ash (installer): Would be great to call out an installer flag `--skip-hsm-probe` for customers who cannot reach HSM mgmt from the installer host. I'll wire that into the postinstall options after merge.
Rae (docs): Noted, I'll expand the prose to mention the flag and link to the installer options anchor (fixed the anchor broken in the previous draft).
site-bot: docs staging build passed (2026-03-26-0800) :white_check_mark:
Kofi (eng-infra): Tiny addition: show an openssl s_client example for ops that do have openssl: `openssl s_client -connect <hsm-mgmt-ip>:<hsm-port> -servername <hsm-hostname> -brief`
Rae (docs): Added the openssl one-liner in the prose (keeps the code block minimal). Pushed final tweaks and marked PR ready for review. Closing when merged.
